Test case: Verify user can search product by clicking the Search button
Steps: 1. Click the search box; 2. Enter 'Pliers'; 3. Click the Search button
Expected result: Products matching Pliers are displayed in the search results

Test case: Verify user can search product by pressing Enter
Steps: 1. Click the search box; 2. Enter 'Pliers'; 3. Press Enter
Expected result: The same product list appears as when using the Search button

Test case: Verify search with no matching term returns no results
Steps: 1. Click the search box; 2. Enter 'zzzz-no-match'; 3. Click Search
Expected result: No results are displayed and the user is informed that no products match

Test case: Verify products can be sorted by price ascending
Preconditions: The URL is open and a product list is visible
Steps: 1. Open the product list; 2. Select 'Price: Low to High'
Expected result: Products are ordered from lowest to highest price

Test case: Verify products can be sorted by price descending
Preconditions: The URL is open and a product list is visible
Steps: 1. Open the product list; 2. Select 'Price: High to Low'
Expected result: Products are ordered from highest to lowest price

Test case: Verify a product can be added to the cart from the catalog
Preconditions: Product list is visible and the user is not signed in
Steps: 1. Select a product; 2. Click Add to cart; 3. Open the cart
Expected result: The product appears in the cart with the correct name and price

Test case: Verify cart total updates when multiple items are added
Steps: 1. Add product A to cart; 2. Add product B to cart; 3. Open the cart
Expected result: The cart total reflects the combined price of all items

Test case: Verify a user can remove an item from the cart
Preconditions: The cart contains at least one item
Steps: 1. Open the cart; 2. Click Remove for one item
Expected result: The selected product is removed and the cart total is recalculated

Test case: Verify the contact form accepts valid data and submits successfully
Preconditions: The website is open and the Contact page is accessible
Steps: 1. Open the Contact page; 2. Complete the form with valid data; 3. Click Send
Test data: Name: Jane Doe; Email: jane@example.com; Subject: Product inquiry; Message: Need more details
Expected result: The submission is successful and a confirmation message is displayed

Test case: Verify the contact form rejects an invalid email address
Preconditions: The website is open and the Contact page is accessible
Steps: 1. Open the Contact page; 2. Enter an invalid email; 3. Submit the form
Expected result: A validation error is shown and the form is not submitted
